name: Dawuni Grains
description: One-page site for a grain aggregator and outgrower scheme in Tamale that serves two audiences: buyers (feed mills, poultry farms, processors) and smallholder farmers. Kraft paper, laterite red, maize gold and indigo, Shantell Sans headings with Inter body and Big Shoulders Stencil figures. It has a full-bleed harvest hero with a sample bag tag, two doors (buying / farming), a live northern-season track that changes its advice through the year, a dark market price board with per-row quote requests, buyer terms, five quality checks with specs, a numbers band, a farmer package with a season calculator that shows repayment in bags before signing, districts and delivery times, FAQ, and tabbed buyer and farmer forms with a field-officer language choice.
